verdict: Plays clean: cleared, no console error, every spot reachable; the rival (Silvane), the trial (a horde), the ruler (the Bell Below; the bot lost the first try and won the second, as a person may) and the gate (Kaia) all played.

found.title: The Bell Below is a bell in the Codex, a judge on the floor
found.text: The Codex: “The harbour's old bell ... It rings underwater, and something answers.” Floor 7 draws it with the Tide Judge's model (a robed figure), as RULER_OF puts the Judge on floors 5, 7 and 8 (floor 8's Lantern Leviathan, “a great fish”, too). The ruler models' names and floors were left to you when the models were made; this is one more reason to look: the Codex could say the bell's ringer is what climbers fight, or these two floors get rulers of their own.

found.text: Pines on the hills and the cliff top, boats on the sea, houses on their plinths, three shells just under the sand. Nothing in the air.
